attr.title: Vurus
attr.desc: Native reimplementation of Vyruz: Destruction of the Untel Empire using the player's original game resources. OpenGL ES 3.0 renderer, SDL2 controller input and audio; scales to any screen size and aspect. Includes an optional benchmark launcher.
attr.inst: Extract Vurus.sh and the vurus folder into the ports folder. Put your own original Vyruz ISO or single BIN/CUE inside vurus/, beside vurus.aarch64; on first launch the built-in importer creates vurus/data/. Saves and settings are kept beside the executable. Requires AArch64 firmware with OpenGL ES 3.0 and SDL 2.0.18 or newer.
